messages:
Elaine Park: Heads-up — we need a compact rollout plan for the cross-account routing flag. Customers on Dedicated and Private asked for opt-in before we flip default.
Ash Patel: +1. Do we want a staged region approach or tenant-by-tenant canary?
Miguel Ramos: My vote is staged regions for initial perf signal, then tenant opt-ins for behavior/edge cases. Regions give clear traffic slices for latency/cost testing.
Jamal Chen: Can we define exact metrics to gate each stage? SLOs and regression windows.
Elaine Park: Proposed gating: 1) infra health (CPU/GPU util & tail latency) 2) correctness (chat turn failure rate) 3) economics (tokens/sec cost delta). Thresholds: infra < 5% degradation, failure rate <0.2% absolute, cost delta <8% for same QPS.
Ash Patel: Suggest adding user-impact sentinel: top-100 customers error delta <0.5%. Also require no cascading fallbacks >2x baseline.
Miguel Ramos: For A/B, we run 10% traffic to variant for 48h in a region. Metric windows: 15m realtime alerts + 24h aggregate check.
Elaine Park: Operational steps:
```
1) Create feature flag `cross-account-routing.v1` with stages: off -> region-staged -> opt-in-customers -> default-on.
2) Region canary schedule: EU-west -> US-east -> AP-south (48h each).
3) During region canary run A/B (10% variant) for 48h -> expand to 50% for 24h if green.
```
Ash Patel: Who owns customer opt-in list + comms? Support + AE should coordinate onboarding doc and reverse-compat notes.
Jamal Chen: Support Bot should auto-create tracking tickets for each opt-in customer and attach their SLAs.
Support Bot: Created template: `Opt-in Request` — use `/support create optin --customer <tenant> --flag cross-account-routing.v1`.
Miguel Ramos: Rollback policy: automatic rollback if any of the hard gates fail (infra or correctness) OR manual kill-switch if top-customer complaints >3 within 1h.
Elaine Park: Add a soft fallback behavior: when fallback triggered, route to previous model variant but keep serving with reduced throughput (throttle) so user requests still succeed. Document in runbook.
Ash Patel: Eval plan: collect qualitative samples from top-10 customers during opt-in, run prompt-specific regression checks using the eval harness.
Jamal Chen: Alerting: create a `Routing-Canary` dashboard and alerts: latency_p50/p95, model_error_rate, fallback_rate, cost_per_token. Assign to eng-oncall.
Miguel Ramos: Timeline proposal: week 0 prep & comms, week 1 EU canary, week 3 US canary, week 5 AP canary, week 6 open opt-ins, week 8 default-on for non-sensitive customers.
Elaine Park: Decision checklist before each advance: metrics green, no critical customer reports, runbook signed off, support/AE notified.
Ash Patel: I'll draft the runbook and flag config today and ping eng-runtime to schedule kernel tests.
DeployBot: deploy pipeline started for `cross-account-routing.v1` feature-flag config (dry-run).
Elaine Park: Thanks — keeping this thread as source of truth for the rollout plan and postmortem notes. If anyone has objections to thresholds/timing call them out now.
Miguel Ramos: One ask — add an A/B exposure tag in telemetry so we can slice logs by variant quickly.
Ash Patel: noted. I'll add `ab_variant: cross-account-routing.v1` to request metadata.
Jamal Chen: Also add a retention note — keep canary traces for 90 days for regression triage.
Elaine Park: Done. Closing the loop: I'll send an official slack announcement to #eng-runtime and #support after runbook + flag are in the repo. :rocket:
